skills.description: AI-powered plant root health analysis from transparent pots or smart seedling boxes. Uses fixed cameras to capture images/videos of plant roots, identifies root tip color (white=active, brown=aging, black=rotten), root hair density, branching structure, and detects root rot symptoms (softness, mucus, blackish-brown color). Outputs a root health score (0-100) and vitality grade (Healthy/Normal/Weak/Rotten).
